sources.name: Dicastery for the Causes of Saints
sources.notes: Primary Dicastery source for causes, decrees and recognition lifecycle events; not treated as a complete historical saint catalog.

sources.name: Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahdo Church Sunday School Department — Mahibere Kidusan
sources.notes: Church-accredited department publishing saint material and Holy Synod statements. Recognition claims should preserve the Holy Synod as the decision authority.

sources.name: Syriac Orthodox Church of Antioch — Archdiocese of the Western United States
sources.notes: Official archdiocesan source. Its saints page states some listed dates may differ from the official feast day, so it cannot by itself establish a universal Syriac feast date.
